verdict.rationale: Puzzle's marketing docs explicitly describe connecting Stripe (payments), Ramp and Brex (banking/cards) to auto-categorize and reconcile transactions into the ledger, with concrete stats (98% categorization, 3-min reconciliation) showing real automated data flow. However there is no explicit evidence of a payroll system integration (e.g., Gusto, Rippling), so the 'payroll' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: payroll system integration evidence, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor marketing pages.
